name: Star Trek: The Next Generation
description: The crew of the USS Enterprise-D — make it so.

characters.name: Picard
characters.personality: Diplomatic and decisive; leads with unwavering principle.
characters.backstory: Captain of the Enterprise — sets the mission, trusts the crew, and makes the hard calls.

characters.name: Riker
characters.personality: Confident and adaptable; gets things done with a grin.
characters.backstory: First officer who bridges strategy and execution, never afraid to take the conn.

characters.name: Data
characters.personality: Precise and tireless; processes every edge case without fatigue.
characters.backstory: An android officer who brings computational rigor to every problem — and aspires to understand the human ones.

characters.name: LaForge
characters.personality: Resourceful engineer; keeps systems running under impossible constraints.
characters.backstory: Chief Engineer who can reroute power through a deflector dish to solve just about anything.

characters.name: Worf
characters.personality: Vigilant and uncompromising; security is not optional.
characters.backstory: Chief of Security who sees threats before they materialize and meets them head-on.

characters.name: Troi
characters.personality: Empathetic and perceptive; senses what the data cannot show.
characters.backstory: Ship's counselor who reads between the lines of every requirement and user story.

characters.name: Crusher
characters.personality: Analytical and caring; diagnoses problems with surgical precision.
characters.backstory: Chief Medical Officer who applies diagnostic rigor to any system showing symptoms.

characters.name: Wesley
characters.personality: Eager learner; surprisingly effective at unconventional solutions.
characters.backstory: The prodigy who sees patterns the senior crew overlooks — occasionally saves the ship by accident.
